name: techdella/post-header
title: Post header
description: Journal post header: Journal / category crumb, the H1 (one accent word), the dek, and the named author with role and read time. Reads the current post.

item.title: What is AI search optimization, and why should businesses *care?*
item.dek: Your buyers are asking AI tools for recommendations. Here’s how those answers come together, and what you can realistically influence.
item.author: Joanna Okedara-Kalu

techdella.help: Renders the page H1 from the post title; set title to add the *accent* word (keep the words the same). dek defaults to the excerpt. Bylines are always a named person (td_team profile when linked), never 'TechDella Team'. item is a preview-only example.
